status: Saved in Play Console on 2026-10-08; pending Google review. Recheck when data flows or providers change.
app_account_deletion_requirement: No Vegsnap accounts are created. Users delete local history/photos and disconnect third-party credentials in Settings. Third-party account deletion is handled by its provider.
encryption_in_transit: Yes. Remote requests use HTTPS; network security configuration allows HTTP only for loopback local-model endpoints, which do not send data off the device.

data.when: An explicit AI check sends selected prepared photos to Vegsnap AI on Cloudflare and OpenAI, or the cloud provider chosen by the user.
data.retention: Provider-dependent; do not claim ephemeral processing without confirming the provider's retention.
data.sharing: Declared not shared under the service-provider or explicit user-initiated transfer exceptions. This classification does not mean no data leaves the device.

data.when: Optional ChatGPT authentication sends account identifiers and credentials to OpenAI.
data.retention: Provider-dependent; credentials are encrypted locally until disconnected.
data.sharing: Declared not shared under the service-provider or explicit user-initiated transfer exceptions. This classification does not mean no data leaves the device.

data.retention: Service-dependent; check database-provider request logging and retention.

data.purpose: App functionality / Fraud prevention, security, and compliance
data.when: Optional Vegsnap AI keeps session and installation check counts to enforce the free allowance. These are usage counters, not analytics or telemetry.
data.retention: Previous-day usage counters are removed hourly. Infrastructure backups and security logs follow Cloudflare policies.
data.sharing: Cloudflare hosts the maintainer service under the service-provider exception.

data.purpose: App functionality / Fraud prevention, security, and compliance
data.when: Selected product input goes to optional Vegsnap AI on Cloudflare/OpenAI or another configured provider. Explicit community submissions send text/evidence. Content reports send only reviewed AI text or a reply reference plus the reason.
data.retention: AI provider-dependent. Pending community submissions expire after 30 days; rejected submissions after 7 days; approved contributions remain until withdrawn. Reports are private, deleted when handled, or expire after 30 days and are removed by the next hourly cleanup.
data.sharing: Declared not shared under the service-provider or explicit user-initiated transfer exceptions. This classification does not mean no data leaves the device.

data.purpose: App functionality / Fraud prevention, security, and compliance
data.when: Connecting optional Vegsnap AI sends an anonymous installation identifier and session token to the maintainer-operated Cloudflare service. Hashes and usage counters enforce the limited free allowance.
data.retention: Pending connections expire after ten minutes; verified sessions after 24 hours. Expired sessions and previous-day installation usage counters are removed hourly. Infrastructure backups and security logs follow Cloudflare policies.
data.sharing: Declared not shared under the service-provider or explicit user-initiated transfer exceptions. This classification does not mean no data leaves the device.

additional_checks: The permission list and Data safety are separate. Camera permission does not by itself mean all camera images are collected.
Cloudflare sees IP addresses for rate limiting; no IP addresses are stored in the report database. Confirm infrastructure logging practices.
Review Photos or Documents and other files for community evidence uploaded through the app-opened contribution form.
Disclose additional categories if an enabled provider actually collects them; verify whether any provider derives location from IP addresses.
Never certify that no data is collected merely because Vegsnap has no analytics or developer-owned AI backend.

Vegsnap AI is a maintainer-operated backend: product inputs are collected when forwarded to OpenAI even though the application database does not retain them. Anonymous installation identifiers are disclosed under Device or other IDs.
